ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C2-2,
Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District and RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached
House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 22-G and Map No. 22-H in
the area bound by:

The alley next east of and parallel to South Ashland Avenue; West 94" Street; South
Ashland Avenue; a line 144.0 feet north of and parallel to West 94" Street; the alley next
west of and parallel to South Ashland Avenue; West 93" Place; South Ashland Avenue;
West 93 Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Ashland Avenue; the south
line of Chicago, Rock Island and Pacific Railroad,

to those of a B3-2, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Ronnie Mosley
Alderman, 21%* Ward

Common Address:
8901-9357 S. Ashland Avenue
8900-9258 S. Ashland Avenue
9334-44 S. Ashland Avenue
